jei.aeallpattern.pattern_binder.info: Right-click a Pattern Linker, then sneak-right-click a supported machine. The server publishes that machine's deterministic recipes directly to the connected AE2 network.
jei.aeallpattern.pattern_linker.info: Consumes one AE2 channel and 2 AE/t. Virtual processing patterns are visible in AE2 crafting terminals; machine output must have a route back into the network.
